newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends quiet day in range, firm vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends quiet day in range, firm vs dlr.

text.p: 1520 GMT - The Swiss franc ended a quiet day slightly firmer against the dollar and mark, but off highs after strong gains Monday. Sterling rose against the franc.
"It has been bit of a strange day. Sterling has been boosted by the Bank of England's (BOE) inflation report," said one London-based trader.
The BOE on Tuesday said that interest rates would have to be increased again in order to hit an official inflation target of 2.5 percent.
The Swiss franc had been quite stable, the trader added.

It was firmer versus closing levels against the mark after the German unit fell to its lowest levels since November on Monday. But the mark was able to gain from the Tuesday's opening of 84.28/30 Swiss centimes.

In addition some short yen/long Swiss positions were reversed, the trader said. * The dollar ended slightly weaker at 1.4340/4350 Swiss francs versus 1.4350/4360 francs at the close on Monday. * The mark ended lower at 84.40/42 versus 84.43/45.
* Sterling was higher at 2.3350/3374 Swiss francs versus 2.3218/3241 late on Monday. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
